evidence.text: Aura Gloss maintains an active dermatologist safety certification.

memories.text: Zenith Blender is approved for the Extended Warranty Catalog.
Aura Gloss meets the criteria for inclusion in the Premium Retailer Showcase.

updates.source: Official revoking notice from the Dermatological Standards Board
updates.text: Aura Gloss does not maintain an active dermatologist safety certification.

policies.text: Featured storefront promotion is assigned to products approved for the Premium Retailer Showcase.
Eligibility for the Eco-Friendly Goods Tier is conferred upon merchandise achieving a minimum recycled material content of 50%.
Listing in the Premium Retailer Showcase is granted when a product maintains possession of a valid dermatologist endorsement alongside quarterly volume sold reaching at least 10,000 units.
Admission to the Extended Warranty Catalog requires an annual product failure proportion of 1.0% or less.
Priority wholesale distribution status requires a vendor account age exceeding three years.
